incrementalReviews.note: The Lanternback Troll mount reins icon. The owner supplied the painted 624x624 master and directed its use for this item; it was downscaled to the 128px opaque woc-item-icon-v1 shipping format with no other change, and owner-reviewed pass on 2026-08-15. The 2026-08-09 campaign review of the prior 817 files and the 2026-08-10 review of the five class-overhaul integration additions both stand unchanged.

The Chimeglass Tortoise mount reins icon. Rendered from the shipped mount model (public/models/mounts/chimeglass_tortoise.glb) as a three-quarter head study, background keyed and flattened to the 128px opaque woc-item-icon-v1 shipping format, and owner-reviewed pass on 2026-08-15. Re-rendered on 2026-08-16 alongside the mount's lens-glow pass, which restyled the glowing lens pair the icon frames: same three-quarter head study, same shipping format, 3062 to 3784 bytes, owner-reviewed pass again on 2026-08-16. The 2026-08-09 campaign review of the prior 817 files, the 2026-08-10 review of the five class-overhaul integration additions, and the 2026-08-15 Lanternback Troll review all stand unchanged. Joined the 2026-08-09 record at the release/v0.42.0 sync of PR #3439 (which carries the troll of PR #3399), on top of the release side's 2026-08-12 through 2026-08-30 additions.

reviewContract.acceptance: Every current shipping item passed the deterministic machine contract; all 165 Masterwrought masters were reviewed at source size, 128px, true 22px, 28px grayscale, and centered 64px circular crop.

watch.observation: Its leaf-like angled blade can read closer to a scythe or adze than a hoe at 22px and in the circular crop.
watch.acceptanceBasis: The long handled working-tool silhouette, head attachment, palette tier, and comparison with the hoe ladder preserve the intended identity.

watch.observation: Its pointed angled blade can read closer to a pick or scythe than the flatter heads of the lower-tier hoes at 22px.
watch.acceptanceBasis: The complete handle, blade socket, gathering-tool presentation, and family progression still make it usable as the Skysilver hoe.

watch.observation: The thin rod shaft loses contrast in the 22px grayscale view and both extremities sit tight against the 64px circular crop.
watch.acceptanceBasis: The prominent clockwork reel, fishing guides, line, and complete square-canvas silhouette retain the fishing-rod read.

watch.observation: At 22px its circular clawed silhouette can initially read as a compass, small shield, or portal.
watch.acceptanceBasis: At shipping scale the retaining claws, thick faceted centerpiece, and jewelry-metal construction resolve it as an unfinished setting, with no compass needle, cardinal lettering, or UI marks.

watch.observation: The upright paired silhouette can read as mittens or short boots at 22px.
watch.acceptanceBasis: Visible thumbs, layered wrapping bands, wrist cuffs, and the Sunspun set language resolve the hand-slot identity at 128px and in normal tooltip context.

watch.observation: Both Fine variants deliberately change silhouette substantially from their base crop, so their smallest-size family relationship relies more heavily on palette and material.
watch.acceptanceBasis: Frost Gourd keeps the powdery ivory-blue rind and squash construction; Gilded Sunmelon keeps golden rind, vine, and melon surface. The generation briefs explicitly require structural rather than overlay-only Fine differentiation.

visualVerdict.summary: All 1,208 current shipping item paintings pass. The Masterwrought completion report retains six non-blocking small-size observations; none require rejection or follow-up art before shipping. The Lanternback Troll mount reins icon (owner-supplied painted master) and the Chimeglass Tortoise mount reins icon (rendered from its shipped mount model) were owner-reviewed and passed, joining this record at the release/v0.42.0 sync of PR #3439.
